title: Mayor Owens Appoints Jill Ferguson to Director of Neighborhood Grants
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens appointed Jill Ferguson as Director of Neighborhood Grants within the Department of Neighborhood and Business Development. Ferguson brings 25 years of experience in grants administration, strategic planning, and community engagement, most recently from Syracuse University's Maxwell School. She will oversee the department's federal, state, and local grant portfolio supporting affordable housing and neighborhood development aligned with city priorities.
